fact: 1931年3月5日甘地-欧文协定暂停公民不服从运动、释放政治犯、允许沿海村庄自制食盐；但第二次圆桌会议（1931年9—12月）失败后，1932年初公民不服从运动恢复，英国以严厉镇压应对。

fact: 1932年8月16日英国首相麦克唐纳宣布「教派奖」（Communal Award），为穆斯林、锡克教徒、印度基督徒、英印混血、妇女及「贱民阶层」设立单独选区；9月甘地绝食抗议，与阿姆倍伽尔达成浦那协定（Poona Pact）。

sources.title: The Civil Disobedience Movement 1930-32（CCE LMS, Andhra Pradesh）
sources.quote: On 16th August 1932 Prime Minister Ramsay Macdonald gave his famous Communal Award. Under which not only the Muslims, Indian Christians, Europeans, Anglo-Indians and the Sikhs but also the Harijans were given special representation in the legislatures.

sources.title: Civil Disobedience Movement (1930–34) Upsc Ncert Notes（Andedge）
sources.quote: In protest against the British grant of separate electorates to the Depressed Classes, Gandhi began a 'fast unto death' in jail. Ambedkar conceded to a compromise, known as the Poona Pact of September 1932.

fact: 甘地-欧文协定暂停运动期间，商业活动短暂恢复；但1932年初运动恢复后，英印贸易与抵制英货运动再度紧张，旁遮普农村信贷与土地市场在镇压中波动。

fact: 公民不服从运动1932年初恢复后，英国政府恢复严厉镇压；尽管甘地-欧文协定曾承诺撤回管制国大党活动的法令，运动恢复后这些法令再度生效，政治犯大量被捕。

sources.title: UNIT 15 CIVIL DISOBEDIENCE MOVEMENT（NCERT）
sources.quote: Despite severe repressive measures taken by the British Government to crush the agitation, the movement continued with vigour for about a year and half.
